name: 9ete/remote-media-source
description: Serve media from a remote WordPress site on local/dev/staging environments.

scripts.plugin-check: ./bin/build-zip.sh -q && rm -rf remote-media-source && unzip -q remote-media-source.zip && cd test-envs/source && lando wp plugin install plugin-check --activate && lando wp plugin check /app/wp-content/plugins/remote-media-source/remote-media-source && cd ../.. && rm -rf remote-media-source remote-media-source.zip
